source.name: Ferrari – Ferrari and Shell renew their partnership
source.note: Ferrari's own renewal announcement: the renewed Shell partnership takes effect on 1 January 2026 and explicitly covers the Ferrari Hypercar programme alongside Scuderia Ferrari HP and the Ferrari Challenge. On the 2026 499P launch photos the Shell and V-Power marks sit on the engine cover/sidepod; mapped to front as the programme's title-level partner, mirroring the Scuderia Ferrari kit. The live ferrari.com page blocks scripts (HTTP 403); read via the Wayback Machine capture of 15 April 2025.
source.quote: This agreement, which will take effect on 1 January 2026, encompasses Scuderia Ferrari HP, Ferrari Hypercar, and the Ferrari Challenge Series.

source.note: Ferrari's official Hypercar sponsors page for 2026. The partner board image on the page (SVG board 'd_lmh_partners_prefooter_2026_25mar', dated 25 March 2026 in its file name) shows the Cetilar wordmark; checked visually in the SVG source of the board. The live ferrari.com page blocks scripts (HTTP 403). Ferrari's announcement of 21 February 2024 (ferrari.com/en-EN/hypercar/articles/cetilar-reconfirmed-as-team-partner-of-ferrari-af-corse) documents the partnership; the Cetilar wordmark also appears on the 2026 499P launch photos.

summary: 2026 Ferrari 499P (Ferrari – AF Corse, cars #50 and #51) in the FIA WEC. Shell is the programme's title-level partner (front), renewed with effect from 1 January 2026 explicitly covering the Ferrari Hypercar. Cetilar, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Synopsys appear on the official Ferrari Hypercar partners board for 2026. The list isn't complete: the 2026 livery also carries HP, Richard Mille, CEVA, DHL and Puma marks, not yet sourced to the Hypercar programme; Michelin is the league-wide tyre partner (deals/wec-michelin).
